mapper.select: SELECT area_code FROM public.sd_area_name_alias WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND source_sigungu_name = #{sourceSigunguName} AND ( source_eupmyeondong_name = #{sourceEupmyeondongName} OR source_eupmyeondong_name = '__ALL__' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN source_eupmyeondong_name = #{sourceEupmyeondongName} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.sd_area_floating_population ( area_code, source_code, base_date, hour, sensing_time, registered_at, model_name, serial_no, region, autonomous_district, administrative_district, visitor_count, metadata, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{areaCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{baseDate}, #{hour}, #{sensingTime}, #{registeredAt}, #{modelName}, #{serialNo}, #{region}, #{autonomousDistrict}, #{administrativeDistrict}, #{visitorCount}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (source_code, serial_no, sensing_time) DO UPDATE SET area_code = EXCLUDED.area_code, base_date = EXCLUDED.base_date, hour = EXCLUDED.hour, registered_at = EXCLUDED.registered_at, model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name, region = EXCLUDED.region, autonomous_district = EXCLUDED.autonomous_district, administrative_district = EXCLUDED.administrative_district, visitor_count = EXCLUDED.visitor_count, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
